title: Stack trace or debug error printed (java) — review required
description: Code in java prints a stack trace or debug error: e.printStackTrace(). Traces leak paths, versions, library names, and code structure to whoever can trigger them. This lexical rule flags the print; the reviewer confirms it never reaches untrusted output.
remediation: Log a correlation id with a correlation-id log call and show users a generic message; keep traces server-side.
limitation: Lexical, line-based: matches the print regardless of output destination.
